title: PriorityRequestReceived
description: A priority request was presented at a signalled crossing or junction. Carries the entitlement class and no subject reference: honouring the request means extending a green, which needs no per-person state. Recording who crossed which road when, for seven days, in order to lengthen a phase would buy a surveillance capability with no operational return. Where abuse must be controlled, the controller rate-limits on local presence and emits nothing.

asset_ref.description: Crossing or junction the request was presented at.

entitlement_class.description: Class of entitlement presented. Not an identity. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

request_id.description: Per-request random identifier, used only to pair a request with its grant. Not stable across requests and not derivable from the presenter.

granted.description: Whether the controller honoured the request.

extension_ms.description: Additional green time granted, milliseconds. Zero when not granted.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
